title: Chief Human Resource Officer Programme (The CHRO Program)
description: Embark on a 12 month learning journey in Talent Acquisition, Leadership Development, and HR Analytics.

content.title: Who Should Join
points: Senior HR Professionals: Enhance strategic leadership skills
HR Directors: Transition into the CHRO role
HR Business Partners: Influence organizational strategy and transformation
Talent Leaders: Develop advanced people management capabilities
HR Consultants: Expand knowledge in strategic HR planning
Business Leaders: Build robust HR systems for success

points: 14 Modules – Talent Acquisition, Leadership Development, and HR Analytics

curriculum.title: Project: Capstone Project
points: Design an enterprise-wide people strategy aligned with organizational growth and transformation goals. Develop recommendations across talent, culture, workforce transformation, and HR technology while leveraging technologies and AI-driven insights. Present a boardroom-ready roadmap that enables sustainable business performance, strengthens organizational capability, and positions HR as a strategic driver of enterprise value.
